description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended sacituzumab govitecan, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for treating unresectable triple-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer in adults after 2 or more systemic therapies, at least 1 of which was for advanced disease. Sacituzumab govitecan is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
